name: Namangan

queries.query: Namangan city official cadastral office public parcel map geoportal Uzbekistan
queries.result: The official Cadastre Agency’s Namangan office listing names Namangan city and its cadastral divisions. The national geoportal offers a cadastral-number search, and State Urban Cadastre advertises public data, but neither public property schema nor city-scoped parcel geometry was verified.

Milliy geoportal va davlat shaharsozlik kadastri umumiy ochiq ma’lumotlarni ko‘rsatadi, ammo Namangan shahriga tegishli xavfsiz vektor sxemasi aniqlanmadi.

queries.query: Наманган кадастровое управление город кадастровая карта официальный геопортал участок
queries.result: Официальные страницы подтверждают кадастровое подразделение в городе Наманган и действующие кадастровые работы в области. Публичный национальный геопортал требует ознакомиться с условиями использования; городская схема безопасных атрибутов и доступность полной геометрии не подтверждены.

portals.observation: Official Uzbekistan Cadastre Agency listing includes Namangan city among the regional cadastral offices/divisions. The site timed out during direct retrieval; indexed first-party result was used, and no outage conclusion is made.
Cadastre Agency news (2026-07-29) reports ongoing technical inventory of real-estate objects in Namangan Region; province-wide counts are not treated as city coverage.

National Cadastre Agency Geoportal shell advertises cadastral-number search and displays a public-offer consent dialog. No consent, search or feature request was submitted; no safe property schema was verified.
State Urban Cadastre portal describes general public and restricted user data and urban-planning layers; its public data scope is not shown to include Namangan cadastral parcels.
Official city administration page identifies Namangan City Administration and its office, confirming city context but not parcel data.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: The official Uzbekistan Cadastre Agency lists a Namangan city cadastre office and city cadastral divisions; current agency reporting also documents cadastral inventory work in Namangan Region. This establishes city-local cadastral administration, but not public city parcel-vector access. National geoportal and State Urban Cadastre are candidates, not yet verified as city-feature sources.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The local cadastral office is confirmed, but the national public geoportal presents a terms-consent step and no documented geometry/property allowlist was found. The city-scoped vector layer and privacy-safe feature contract remain unverified; no parcel query was made.
